gloss: while driving; while in motion; while running (of a vehicle)

definitions.gloss: while driving; while in motion; while running (of a vehicle)
definitions.explanation: Describes the state of a vehicle being in motion on the road or tracks. Frequently seen on safety signs and in traffic regulations, and almost always refers to vehicles rather than people.

examples.japanese: {走行中|そうこうちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦シートベルト→シートベルト：29083_shiitoberuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}して→着用する：26849_chakuyousuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wear your seatbelt while the vehicle is in motion.

examples.japanese: {走行中|そうこうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Using a smartphone while driving is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {走行中|そうこうちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まって→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The engine suddenly stopped while driving, and it was a very scary experience.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{走行|そうこう}→走行：14260_soukou⟧ (traveling, running of a vehicle) and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during). Refers to the state of a vehicle being in motion. Very commonly seen on signs, in safety instructions, and in traffic-related contexts. Almost always refers to vehicles (cars, trains, buses), not people running.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {走行中|そうこうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧: a vehicle in motion
- {走行中|そうこうちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}たないで→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please do not stand while the vehicle is moving
- {走行中|そうこうちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{異音|いおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hear a strange noise while driving

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{運転中|うんてんちゅう}→運転中：09659_untenchuu⟧ — while driving (focuses on the driver's activity)
- ⟦{停車中|ていしゃちゅう}→停車中：24482_teishachuu⟧ — while stopped (the opposite state)
- ⟦{移動中|いどうちゅう}→移動中：26486_idouchuu⟧ — while moving; in transit (broader, includes walking or any travel)
